title: Maya Mouse's Lost Thimble
description: Maya Mouse loses her favorite silver sewing thimble in the tall clover and learns that asking friends for help makes any search an adventure.
character_reference: a tiny brown field mouse with oversized round ears, twitching pink whiskers, and a patchwork vest made of green wool

scenes.narration: Maya clutched her tiny sewing basket tightly as she searched her cozy burrow for her favorite shiny silver thimble.
scenes.visual: close-up of tiny paws frantically rummaging through an overturned woven basket filled with colorful yarn scraps

scenes.narration: It had rolled out the front door and tumbled straight down into the thick, emerald green clover patch.
scenes.visual: ground-level view peering out through giant dewy clover leaves toward an open grassy meadow

scenes.narration: Feeling overwhelmed by the giant leaves, Maya sat down on a smooth pebble and let out a quiet sigh.
scenes.visual: sad drooping posture sitting hunched over on a damp round stone surrounded by towering blades of grass

scenes.narration: Just then, Barnaby Beetle crawled up the stem, offering a cheerful wave with his front leg.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a shiny beetle perched on a bending stem looking down encouragingly

scenes.narration: Together, they peeked under every leaf and mossy root until something bright caught the afternoon sun.
scenes.visual: two tiny characters side by side lifting a heavy fern frond together in a sunlit patch of earth

scenes.narration: Maya held up the sparkling silver thimble with a joyful squeak, thanking her wonderful little helper.
scenes.visual: enthusiastic close-up holding a tiny metal cup aloft while beaming a wide happy smile

scenes.narration: Troubles are always smaller when we share them with friends.
scenes.visual: two tiny animals sitting happily together eating a blackberry under the afternoon shade

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: warm glowing close-up of a friendly woodland creature waving happily toward the camera
